spectralLabPage.title: Spectral lab
spectralLabPage.subtitle: spatial profile of one SPHEREx exposure · not a full spectrum
spectralLabPage.noCutouts: Prepare cutouts (Time explorer, manual comparison) to extract the spatial profile of an exposure.
spectralLabPage.noSamples: Without samples there is no curve. Run an extraction on a real cutout. The result is a spatial profile of a single exposure, not a 102-channel spectrum.
spectralLabPage.noMolecules: This lab does not identify molecules: any physical interpretation requires appropriate models and references.
spectralLabPage.chooseTarget: Pick a target to measure its spectrum on the fly (relative spectrophotometry, distinct from the spatial profile above).

candidatesPage.title: Candidates
candidatesPage.subtitle: signals the difference engine flagged for review; none is confirmed
candidatesPage.emptyBody: Candidates appear here only when the science engine measures something in real images (Time explorer → Difference analysis). This platform does not invent signals: no measurement, no candidate.
